title: lava serve --json
description: Starts the PHP built-in server on the app's public/ directory. The envelope is emitted BEFORE the server starts serving, so a caller can read the URL off stdout and then make requests — which is how the framework's own HTTP tests drive a real SAPI. `booted` is informational, not fatal: a broken app must still be servable, because public/index.php is what renders the diagnostics page explaining the breakage.

workers.description: PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS for the child — the built-in server is single-request without it.

url.description: The URL to request, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080.

doc_root.description: Relative to the app root; static files are served from here without booting the app.

entry_point.description: Relative to the app root; every non-static request runs this file.

booted.description: Whether the app booted cleanly at start. False means the first request will render a diagnostics page or a JSON problem, not the app's routes.
